review_method: Independent read-only agent context; global bookkeeping checks plus sampled visual/source review.

findings.description: Numbered-only sections could count as complete without a catalogue. Final closure now requires explicit catalogue coverage for every content-bearing section.
A reviewed catalogue could be changed, including removing fine source subdivisions, without invalidating review. Catalogue review now fingerprints the catalogue and its source census.
List/table subdivision completeness still needs source review. Sampling and structural extraction are not a full independent visual audit.
A continued printed note may have separate census anchors, such as 18.3.7#note4 and #note4.2. Both regions must be accounted for.
Inventory page positions are starts, not complete ranges. Read through the next source section boundary; outline bookmark destinations can precede actual body headings.
